title: Currency on another device
text: T-3572: the Japanese player's "money 150x on another device" is the per-browser currency: a Japanese browser starts on yen, so the same game shows every figure in yen there and dollars elsewhere. Fix: store the chosen currency in each save so every device shows the game in the currency it was saved in (about 1-1.5 h; old saves keep the device's choice), or only a one-time note on a new device naming the currency (about 1 h)? Pick: store it in the save.
